# JacoChen | AI Architect

> Building enterprise AI platforms from scratch. LangGraph, MongoDB, RAG, and the trade-offs nobody talks about.

## llms.txt

This site contains technical blog posts about enterprise AI architecture, written by an AI architect who built and shipped a production AI workbench serving ~300 users.

## Topics covered

- LangGraph orchestration (stateful graphs, interrupt/resume, sub-graph composition)
- MongoDB semantic layers ($set additive collapse, not $project)
- Anti-hallucination engineering (7-layer defense, 35% → 7%)
- Intent routing systems (11-intent catalog, vector shortcircuit + LLM fallback)
- K8s sandbox security (YARA scanning, NetworkPolicy isolation, ephemeral Jobs)
- AI observability without LangSmith (8-table lineage system)
- Prompt engineering as "semantic mapping" (not conversation)
- Context engineering and memory systems
- Token economics and cost attribution
